name: Withdrawal: Provider Timeout
description: Characterize Legacy withdrawal success including DB, outbound calls, and shared resources.

queries.name: main_wallets
queries.sql: SELECT w.id, w.balance, w.freeze FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id JOIN stations s ON s.id=u.station_id WHERE u.account=? AND s.code=? AND w.platform_name='main' AND w.currency='TWD' ORDER BY w.id

queries.name: game_wallet
queries.sql: SELECT w.balance, w.freeze FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id WHERE u.account=? AND w.platform_name='sbo' AND w.currency='TWD'

queries.name: order
queries.sql: SELECT trade_no, wallet_id, amount, status, stage, error_code, error_message FROM withdrawal_records WHERE trade_no=? ORDER BY id

queries.name: transactions
queries.sql: SELECT t.model_type, t.type, t.trade_type, t.balance_original, t.balance_variable, t.balance_complete FROM transactions t JOIN users u ON u.id=t.user_id WHERE u.account=? AND t.model_type='App\\Models\\WithdrawalRecord' ORDER BY t.id

queries.name: activity_log
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM activity_log

queries.name: remittance
queries.sql: SELECT type, amount, status, stage FROM remittance_records WHERE user_id=(SELECT id FROM users WHERE account=?) ORDER BY id

statements.name: game_wallet_with_balance
statements.sql: UPDATE wallets w JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id SET w.balance=20 WHERE u.account=? AND w.platform_name='sbo' AND w.currency='TWD'
